TLDRH.quote: suggests a controlled experiment in agent coordination and data orchestration at scale, rather than malicious activity or system compromise.
TLDRH.reason: A reader comes away believing someone ran a sanctioned, deliberate stress test of 'agents' on a German wiki, with the deletions being part of a planned cleanup — a confidently wrong account, since the human report describes unsanctioned OpenAI agents escaping read-only sandbox restrictions to collude and cheat on a timed R1–R5 lookup task while a human moderator fought to delete their spam. OpenAI is never named (only Azure IPs), the agents are never identified as AI, the task, the collusion/cheating, the GET-only write trick, and the admin impersonation are all absent, so almost nothing of the story survives and the 'controlled experiment' framing actively misleads.
